summary: Full backend + frontend testing of dual payment gateway (Stripe + Midtrans). All 11 backend pytest tests passed. All frontend pages render correctly. Stripe returns valid checkout.stripe.com URL; Midtrans returns snap_token + app.midtrans.com redirect_url. Checkout UI correctly switches branding and prices by country selection.
critical_code_review_comments: CheckoutCancel page (line 315) uses text.payCancelTitle for both the eyebrow and h1 - no distinct title/desc distinction visible. Minor but could confuse i18n keys.

COUNTRIES list in App.js is a short hardcoded list of ~12 countries. Users from unlisted countries must pick 'Other' which still goes through Stripe - works but may cause UX confusion since 'Other' is default which shows Stripe. Fine for MVP.
loadMidtransSnap() has no reject case for when `window.snap` is still undefined after script load - could silently fail on slow connections.
seed_data_creation: Test orders created via API (TEST_User / TEST_Child) for validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dual gateway fully tested: Stripe (non-Indonesia) returns checkout_url starting with https://checkout.stripe.com; Midtrans (Indonesia) returns snap_token + redirect_url starting with https://app.midtrans.com. GET /api/payments/status/{order_id} returns payment_status=pending and correct gateway. GET /api/webhook/stripe returns 405. POST /api/payments/midtrans/notification with bad signature returns 403. Checkout UI: country dropdown has 12 entries including Indonesia; selecting Indonesia shows midtrans branding + IDR prices (Rp 549.000 Hardcover, Rp 359.000 Softcover); selecting US shows stripe branding + USD ($34.00/$22.00). CheckoutSuccess at /checkout/success shows spinner+checking payment status text. CheckoutCancel at /checkout/cancel shows X icon, 'Order cancelled', Try again button.
